preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'WhatsApp Staff Campaign - Active Staff by Office'

column.name: report_name
column.value: WhatsApp Staff Campaign - Active Staff by Office

column.name: description
column.value: Active staff with a mobile number, for WhatsApp employee campaigns

insert.column: SELECT s.id AS id, s.mobile_no AS mobileNo, s.display_name AS FullName, s.firstname AS firstname, s.lastname AS lastname, o.id AS officeId, o.name AS officeName FROM m_staff s JOIN m_office o ON o.id = s.office_id WHERE s.is_active = true AND s.mobile_no IS NOT NULL AND s.mobile_no <> '' AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ounder.hierarchy FROM m_office ounder WHERE ounder.id = ${officeId}), '%')
